text_block_list.name: Gourmet Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
That dessert buffet yesterday was so delicious!
My energy is fully recharged~♪

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
M-More importantly... Is Bourbon looking this way?
Is she mad? Were we being too loud...?

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text: That low tone! Could that be the error sound Bourbon-san makes when she's mad... !?

text_block_list.name: Gourmet Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawa, I got way too energetic!
I'm sorry! I'll go blow off some steam by running!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: No, I want to hear more details about this energy-refilling method—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A misunderstanding arose from my facial expression and the sounds from my stomach, causing the target to flee.
Due to the thick crowd, pursuit is... difficult.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Conclusion... communication remains
an operation of maximum difficulty...
